## Module to write
path: ServerScriptService/ForgeChecks.server.luau
purpose: Feature: Create executable checks (forge checks --plan) that run a live playtest and assert the telemetry counters: map_built=1, plaza_built=1, themes_built=6, plot_assigned (after claim or the 20s auto-claim), auto_claims, cubes_dropped rising about every 2s, cubes_collected rising, cashin_fx_sent>0, and Cash rising. Also assert that there are no output errors or warnings and that cubes_dropped stays 0 before a claim. Run them, then hand any failing check to the fixer. Keep existing counter names unchanged. -- Studio-only runner (returns immediately unless RunService:IsStudio()) that executes the plan from ForgeChecksPlan. It subscribes to LogService.MessageOut from the start and records Error and Warning entries, ignoring lines that start with its own '[ForgeCheck]' prefix. It waits for the first player and for map_built, plaza_built and themes_built, then snapshots telemetry through ForgeTelemetry.get/snapshot. During the pre-claim window it samples cubes_dropped and plot_assigned and records whether cubes_dropped stayed 0 before any claim. Claim phase: in 'auto' mode it waits for the 20s auto-claim and asserts plot_assigned and auto_claims rose. In 'gate' mode (Workspace attribute ForgeCheckMode='gate') it pivots the player's character onto the first unclaimed gate part to trigger the real Touched claim and asserts plots_claimed and plot_assigned rose. After the claim it samples cubes_dropped, cubes_collected and the player's leaderstats Cash every 2.5s for about 4 windows, then checks cashin_fx_sent>0 and the Output log. For each check it prints one line, '[ForgeCheck] PASS <id>' or '[ForgeCheck] FAIL <id> expected=<..> actual=<..>' (via print, never warn), then a final single line '[ForgeCheck] RESULT {json}' with {passed, failed, failures:[{id, expected, actual}]} that the CLI parses to hand each failing check to the fixer. It sets Workspace attribute ForgeChecksDone=true when finished. It only reads game state and never mutates cash, plots or existing counters. It bumps only its own counters 'checks_passed' and 'checks_failed' with ForgeTelemetry.count. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: checks_passed, checks_failed.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/ForgeChecksPlan.luau, ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau

```luau
--!strict
-- ForgeChecksPlan: pure data describing the live playtest check plan.
-- No services, no side effects. Counter names match those used by the game.

local Plan = {
	version = 1,

	-- "auto" waits for the auto-claim fallback; "gate" expects a walk-onto-gate claim.
	claimMode = "auto",

	timing = {
		startupSettle = 3,        -- seconds to let the map/plaza build before observing
		preClaimWindow = 8,       -- observe plaza state before any claim (shorter than 20s auto-claim)
		sampleInterval = 2.5,     -- seconds between counter samples after claim
		maxTotalRun = 50,         -- hard cap on total playtest duration
		autoClaimDelay = 20,      -- spec's auto-claim delay (documentation for the runner)
		claimTimeoutPad = 6,      -- extra seconds allowed after autoClaimDelay before failing
	},

	-- Counters the runner should snapshot at every sample.
	sampledCounters = {
		"map_built",
		"plaza_built",
		"themes_built",
		"plot_assigned",
		"plots_claimed",
		"auto_claims",
		"cubes_dropped",
		"cubes_collected",
		"cashin_fx_sent",
		"upgrades_bought",
	},

	-- Counters this plan reports itself.
	telemetry = {
		passed = "checks_passed",
		failed = "checks_failed",
	},

	checks = {
		{ id = "map_built_once", kind = "counter_eq", counter = "map_built", expect = 1 },
		{ id = "plaza_built_once", kind = "counter_eq", counter = "plaza_built", expect = 1 },
		{ id = "themes_built_six", kind = "counter_eq", counter = "themes_built", expect = 6 },

		{
			id = "no_drops_before_claim",
			kind = "zero_before_claim",
			counter = "cubes_dropped",
			expect = 0,
			gate = "plot_assigned",
		},

		{ id = "plot_assigned_after_claim", kind = "counter_gte", counter = "plot_assigned", expect = 1 },
		{
			id = "auto_claims_in_auto_mode",
			kind = "counter_gte",
			counter = "auto_claims",
			expect = 1,
			onlyMode = "auto",
		},

		{
			id = "cubes_dropped_rising",
			kind = "rising_windows",
			counter = "cubes_dropped",
			expect = 1, -- minimum growth per sample window; faster rates are fine
			window = 2.5,
			startAfter = "plot_assigned",
		},

		{ id = "cubes_collected_positive", kind = "counter_gte", counter = "cubes_collected", expect = 1 },
		{ id = "cashin_fx_sent_positive", kind = "counter_gte", counter = "cashin_fx_sent", expect = 1 },

		{
			id = "cash_rising",
			kind = "cash_rising",
			counter = "Cash", -- leaderstat name, not a telemetry counter
			expect = "greater_than_at_claim",
		},

		{
			id = "no_output_errors",
			kind = "no_output_errors",
			counter = "output",
			expect = 0, -- zero Error or Warning messages in the log
			levels = { "Error", "Warning" },
		},
	},
}

return Plan
```

```luau
--!strict
-- ForgeTelemetry: tiny counter API for generated games. ForgeProbe reports these counters.
--
--   local ForgeTelemetry = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ForgeTelemetry)
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("coins_collected")      -- +1
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("damage_dealt", 25)     -- +25
--   ForgeTelemetry.get()                          -- { coins_collected = 1, damage_dealt = 25 }
--
-- Counters live as number attributes on ServerStorage.ForgeCounters (a Folder), so every VM in the
-- server (game scripts, ForgeProbe, execute_luau) sees the same values. Server only: on the client
-- count() is a no-op and get() returns {}.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForgeCounters"

local ForgeTelemetry = {}

local function folder(): Instance?
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return nil
	end
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- Attribute names: letters, digits and underscores, max 100 chars, may not start with "RBX".
local function key(name: string): string
	local k = string.gsub(tostring(name), "[^%w_]", "_")
	if k == "" then
		k = "_"
	end
	if string.sub(k, 1, 3) == "RBX" then
		k = "_" .. k
	end
	return string.sub(k, 1, 100)
end

function ForgeTelemetry.count(name: string, n: number?)
	local f = folder()
	if not f then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local k = key(name)
		local cur = f:GetAttribute(k)
		local add = tonumber(n) or 1
		f:SetAttribute(k, (if type(cur) == "number" then cur else 0) + add)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- telemetry must never break the game
		return
	end
end

function ForgeTelemetry.get(): { [string]: number }
	local out: { [string]: number } = {}
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return out
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	for k, v in f:GetAttributes() do
		if type(v) == "number" then
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

return ForgeTelemetry
```

# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull. Also keep the second purchase within about 20-30s of idle income, by raising per-item value or lowering the price, so the shop and later upgrades get exercised.
- Do not give starting cash equal to the first upgrade's price. An instant spend gives the player no chase and no sense of what cubes are for. Start slightly below the price so the first few collected cubes earn it, within about 10s.
- The first purchase must actually happen in a short playtest, and its counters (e.g. upgrades_bought) must be above 0. If the report lacks them, the first pad is too hard to find or reach. Put it close to the claimed plot's spawn point, off the walking path, and guide the player to it with a beam. Make sure the tutorial step that points to it fires.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Give failure feedback as well as success feedback. A pad or button pressed without enough cash needs a red flash, an audible buzz and a "Need $N" toast, debounced to about 1s. A silent denial confuses young players.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally. They must still be easy to find and reach: guide the player to the first pad with a visible beam or arrow.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.
- Keep the time to first core-loop activity well inside the playtest window (the probe may last only ~6-15s). An idle player must still reach the loop quickly. Keep the spec's auto-claim delay and the tested window consistent so the plaza state can still be observed before the claim.

```luau
-- ForgeChecks: Studio-only live playtest runner that asserts telemetry counters from ForgeChecksPlan.
-- Read-only with respect to game state (it only moves the player's character in 'gate' mode).

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
if not RunService:IsStudio() then
	return
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LogService = game:GetService("LogService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local PREFIX = "[ForgeCheck]"

local planModule = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeChecksPlan", 15)
local telemetryModule = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry", 15)
if not planModule or not telemetryModule then
	return
end
local Plan = require(planModule)
local Telemetry = require(telemetryModule)

-- Log capture from the very start.
local logIssues: { string } = {}
LogService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message: string, messageType: Enum.MessageType)
	if string.sub(message, 1, #PREFIX) == PREFIX then
		return
	end
	if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError or messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then
		local level = if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError then "Error" else "Warning"
		table.insert(logIssues, level .. ": " .. string.sub(message, 1, 120))
	end
end)

local function snapshot(): { [string]: number }
	local fn = (Telemetry :: any).snapshot or (Telemetry :: any).get
	local ok, res = pcall(fn)
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then
		return res
	end
	return {}
end

local function counter(name: string): number
	local v = snapshot()[name]
	return if type(v) == "number" then v else 0
end

local function getCash(player: Player?): number?
	if not player then
		return nil
	end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local cash = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if cash and (cash:IsA("IntValue") or cash:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return cash.Value
	end
	return nil
end

-- Background monitor: cubes_dropped must stay 0 while no plot is assigned.
local finished = false
local maxDropsBeforeClaim = 0
local sawPreClaimSample = false
task.spawn(function()
	while not finished do
		local snap = snapshot()
		local drops = snap.cubes_dropped or 0 -- read drops first, then assigned (avoids race)
		local snapAssigned = snapshot()
		local assigned = snapAssigned.plot_assigned or 0
		local claimed = snapAssigned.plots_claimed or 0
		if assigned == 0 and claimed == 0 then
			sawPreClaimSample = true
			if drops > maxDropsBeforeClaim then
				maxDropsBeforeClaim = drops
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end)

local passed, failed = 0, 0
local failures: { { id: string, expected: string, actual: string } } = {}

local function report(id: string, ok: boolean, expected: any, actual: any)
	if ok then
		passed += 1
		print(PREFIX .. " PASS " .. id)
		Telemetry.count(Plan.telemetry.passed, 1)
	else
		failed += 1
		print(PREFIX .. " FAIL " .. id .. " expected=" .. tostring(expected) .. " actual=" .. tostring(actual))
		table.insert(failures, { id = id, expected = tostring(expected), actual = tostring(actual) })
		Telemetry.count(Plan.telemetry.failed, 1)
	end
end

local function findGate(player: Player): BasePart?
	for _, d in workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(string.lower(d.Name), "gate", 1, true) and d.Transparency < 0.99 then
			if not (player.Character and d:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)) then
				return d
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local mode = workspace:GetAttribute("ForgeCheckMode")
if mode ~= "gate" and mode ~= "auto" then
	mode = Plan.claimMode
end

local windows: { number } = {}
local maxCash: number? = nil
local claimCash: number? = nil
local claimDetected = false

local function run()
	local timing = Plan.timing
	local startTime = os.clock()

	-- Wait for the first player.
	local player: Player? = nil
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while not player and os.clock() - t0 < 30 do
		player = Players:GetPlayers()[1]
		if not player then
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
	end

	-- Wait for the build counters.
	t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 20 do
		if counter("map_built") >= 1 and counter("plaza_built") >= 1 and counter("themes_built") >= 6 then
			break
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	local remainingSettle = timing.startupSettle - (os.clock() - startTime)
	if remainingSettle > 0 then
		task.wait(remainingSettle)
	end

	local baseAssigned = counter("plot_assigned")
	local baseClaimed = counter("plots_claimed")

	-- Pre-claim observation window.
	task.wait(timing.preClaimWindow)

	-- Claim phase.
	local deadline = os.clock() + timing.autoClaimDelay + timing.claimTimeoutPad
	local lastPivot = 0
	while os.clock() < deadline do
		if counter("plot_assigned") > baseAssigned then
			claimDetected = true
			break
		end
		if mode == "gate" and player and os.clock() - lastPivot > 3 then
			lastPivot = os.clock()
			local character = player.Character
			local gate = findGate(player)
			if character and gate then
				pcall(function()
					character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(gate.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
				end)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	local afterAssigned = counter("plot_assigned")
	local afterClaimed = counter("plots_claimed")
	claimDetected = afterAssigned > baseAssigned
	report("claim_phase_plot_assigned_rose", claimDetected, "> " .. baseAssigned, afterAssigned)
	if mode == "gate" then
		report("claim_phase_plots_claimed_rose", afterClaimed > baseClaimed, "> " .. baseClaimed, afterClaimed)
	end

	-- Post-claim sampling windows.
	if claimDetected then
		claimCash = getCash(player)
		maxCash = claimCash
		local prevDrops = counter("cubes_dropped")
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			if os.clock() - startTime > timing.maxTotalRun + 15 then
				break
			end
			task.wait(timing.sampleInterval)
			local drops = counter("cubes_dropped")
			table.insert(windows, drops - prevDrops)
			prevDrops = drops
			local cash = getCash(player)
			if cash and (not maxCash or cash > maxCash) then
				maxCash = cash
			end
		end
	end
end

local ok, err = pcall(run)
finished = true

-- Evaluate plan checks.
local final = snapshot()
for _, check in Plan.checks do
	local kind = check.kind
	local skip = check.onlyMode and check.onlyMode ~= mode
	if not skip then
		if kind == "counter_eq" then
			local actual = final[check.counter] or 0
			report(check.id, actual == check.expect, check.expect, actual)
		elseif kind == "counter_gte" then
			local actual = final[check.counter] or 0
			report(check.id, actual >= check.expect, ">=" .. tostring(check.expect), actual)
		elseif kind == "zero_before_claim" then
			report(check.id, sawPreClaimSample and maxDropsBeforeClaim == check.expect, check.expect, maxDropsBeforeClaim)
		elseif kind == "rising_windows" then
			local good = claimDetected and #windows > 0
			for _, delta in windows do
				if delta < check.expect then
					good = false
				end
			end
			local actual = if claimDetected then table.concat(windows, ",") else "no claim"
			report(check.id, good, ">=" .. tostring(check.expect) .. " per window", actual)
		elseif kind == "cash_rising" then
			local good = claimCash ~= nil and maxCash ~= nil and maxCash > claimCash
			report(check.id, good, "> " .. tostring(claimCash), tostring(maxCash))
		elseif kind == "no_output_errors" then
			local actual = if #logIssues == 0 then "0" else (#logIssues .. " first=" .. logIssues[1])
			report(check.id, #logIssues == 0, 0, actual)
		end
	end
end

if not ok then
	report("runner_completed", false, "no error", tostring(err))
end

print(PREFIX .. " RESULT " .. HttpService:JSONEncode({
	passed = passed,
	failed = failed,
	failures = failures,
}))
workspace:SetAttribute("ForgeChecksDone", true)
```
